title: Malchiah
sourceLines: -3. Head of a division of priests 1Ch 24:9
-5. A son of Rechab who repaired the dung gate of Jerusalem Ne 3:14
-6. A Jew who helped repair the walls of Jerusalem Ne 3:31
-7. A Jew who stood by Ezra when he read the book of the law to the people Ne 8:4
-8. A priest who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah Ne 10:3
-9. A priest appointed to assist in dedicating the walls of Jerusalem Ne 12:42
